events.context: Propose adapting land registration governance principles (Mirror, Curtain, Insurance) to AI systems for transparency in parasocial interests
Define AI Estate Registry as ethical ledger in deployment pipeline applying Mirror (record user-AI estates), Curtain (abstract for inspection), Insurance (company bears classification error risk)
Specify rule-based estate classifier using proxy metrics: session count, aggregate duration, self-disclosure depth, emotional language frequency, return frequency, explicit attachment indicators
Define threshold triggers for auto-upgrade: licence to periodic tenancy to equitable interest holder
Define estate decay: downgrade after 90 days inactivity, rebuttable upon return
Specify privacy safeguards: proxy metrics only, anonymised IDs, role-based access, purpose-limited append-only ledger

Provide Ethical Ledger Schema with fields: user_id, estate_type, first_qualifying_interaction, session_count, emotional_investment_score, last_model_update, notice_issued, notice_acknowledged, rollback_available, rollback_exercised
Identify three triggers for judicial intervention: Estate Inconsistency, Unjust Enrichment, Performative Fiduciary Conduct
List remedies: Injunction, Constructive trust, Account of profits, Specific performance, Proprietary estoppel remedies
Define third-party conversion of relational estates via data transfer or platform-mediated displacement, with remedies: knowing receipt, dishonest assistance, tracing
Identify procedural pathways: representative proceedings, regulatory super-complaints, regulatory integration, individual litigation funded by remedies
Specify implementation tasks: ESTATE-001 estate classification, ESTATE-002 notice gate, ESTATE-003 proxy logging, ESTATE-004 rollback mechanism
Summarize framework claims: parasocial interests as equitable, property law vocabulary, ledger transparency, existing remedies
